pairs.rationale: BCC context-conditioned MCMC policy sampling/RT stopping differs from TAN-modulated OpAL/Beta uncertainty feedback; shared control vocabulary is not ancestry.

Both inherit RL/actor-style constituents; CTL-02 extends OpAL via uncertainty-dependent decay, whereas LRN-03 trains recurrent policy/value networks by policy gradient.

ECPG learns compressed latent representations under reward; VKF estimates latent state and volatility under a state-space generative model.
Both use policy-gradient RL as an optimization constituent, but ECPG centers representation compression whereas LRN-03 centers recurrent policy/value-network training.
VKF is a volatility-sensitive Bayesian filter; LRN-03 is a recurrent policy-gradient learner with a value baseline.
P11 PBWM gating-demand plus diffusion differs from BCC context-conditioned MCMC planning; CTL-01's DDM relation is comparator-level.
CTL-01 publisher source cites P12, but frozen P12 centers learned value of control/metareasoning over EVC while CTL-01 centers BCC posterior sampling; citation alone is not direct ancestry.
